guides.title: 工程操作與定量驗證手冊
guides.concept: 本課以金屬鹽化學計量、膠體分離與新增污泥為主線，從除磷目標與成分、元素莫耳配比、活性成分日量、藥液濃度與密度進入十個相連的技術單元。每單元依機制、數量模型、驗證與失效辨識逐步操作，最後完成包含單位、敏感度及邊界的工程工作單。數值均為原創教學假設，不是特定設施實測或現場操作設定。
guides.conceptEn: This course develops metal-salt stoichiometry, colloid separation and added sludge through ten connected units, beginning with phosphorus target and fractions, elemental molar ratio, daily active-component mass, solution fraction and density. Each unit moves through mechanism, quantitative model, verification and failure diagnosis, ending in a worksheet with units, sensitivity and applicability. All example numbers are original teaching assumptions, not facility measurements or live operating settings.

evidence: 在離線工作台先選取「除磷目標與成分」的觀測點。對照總磷消化分析與過濾樣本。保留原始數值、單位與時間，將模型預測和量測分欄；偏差未釐清前不把模擬視為現場驗證。
在離線工作台先選取「元素莫耳配比」的觀測點。核對原子量、藥劑活性成分與瓶杯試驗的溶解磷。保留原始數值、單位與時間，將模型預測和量測分欄；偏差未釐清前不把模擬視為現場驗證。
在離線工作台先選取「活性成分日量」的觀測點。以藥液消耗稱重與處理水量交叉核對。保留原始數值、單位與時間，將模型預測和量測分欄；偏差未釐清前不把模擬視為現場驗證。
在離線工作台先選取「藥液濃度與密度」的觀測點。核對供應商分析證明與實測密度、泵標定。保留原始數值、單位與時間，將模型預測和量測分欄；偏差未釐清前不把模擬視為現場驗證。
在離線工作台先選取「快速分散與均勻性」的觀測點。校正軸功率、黏度與有效槽容，觀察局部絮體破碎。保留原始數值、單位與時間，將模型預測和量測分欄；偏差未釐清前不把模擬視為現場驗證。
在離線工作台先選取「膠凝接觸」的觀測點。觀察絮體尺寸、沉降性與攪拌功率。保留原始數值、單位與時間，將模型預測和量測分欄；偏差未釐清前不把模擬視為現場驗證。
在離線工作台先選取「瓶杯試驗與空白」的觀測點。所有杯使用相同攪拌、沉降時間並同時量 pH。保留原始數值、單位與時間，將模型預測和量測分欄；偏差未釐清前不把模擬視為現場驗證。
在離線工作台先選取「固體分離負荷」的觀測點。將流量、池面積與沉降柱結果一起比較。保留原始數值、單位與時間，將模型預測和量測分欄；偏差未釐清前不把模擬視為現場驗證。
在離線工作台先選取「污泥及含磷出口」的觀測點。稱重乾固體後分析 P，與水線進出量閉合。保留原始數值、單位與時間，將模型預測和量測分欄；偏差未釐清前不把模擬視為現場驗證。
在離線工作台先選取「閉合與殘餘金屬」的觀測點。畫出所有邊界流股，分列不確定度及庫存變化。保留原始數值、單位與時間，將模型預測和量測分欄；偏差未釐清前不把模擬視為現場驗證。
evidenceEn: In the offline workbench, select the observation point for phosphorus target and fractions. Compare digested total-P analysis with filtered samples. Retain raw values, units and times, separate predictions from observations, and resolve discrepancies before treating a simulation as field validation.

In the offline workbench, select the observation point for elemental molar ratio. Check atomic masses, reagent active content and dissolved P from jar tests. Retain raw values, units and times, separate predictions from observations, and resolve discrepancies before treating a simulation as field validation.

In the offline workbench, select the observation point for daily active-component mass. Cross-check weighed reagent consumption against treated flow. Retain raw values, units and times, separate predictions from observations, and resolve discrepancies before treating a simulation as field validation.

In the offline workbench, select the observation point for solution fraction and density. Check certificate of analysis, measured density and pump calibration. Retain raw values, units and times, separate predictions from observations, and resolve discrepancies before treating a simulation as field validation.

In the offline workbench, select the observation point for rapid distribution and uniformity. Check shaft power, viscosity and effective volume and observe local floc breakage. Retain raw values, units and times, separate predictions from observations, and resolve discrepancies before treating a simulation as field validation.

In the offline workbench, select the observation point for flocculation exposure. Observe floc size, settleability and mixing power. Retain raw values, units and times, separate predictions from observations, and resolve discrepancies before treating a simulation as field validation.

In the offline workbench, select the observation point for jar testing and controls. Use matching mixing/settling times across jars and measure pH. Retain raw values, units and times, separate predictions from observations, and resolve discrepancies before treating a simulation as field validation.

In the offline workbench, select the observation point for separation loading. Compare flow and plan area with settling-column observations. Retain raw values, units and times, separate predictions from observations, and resolve discrepancies before treating a simulation as field validation.

In the offline workbench, select the observation point for sludge and phosphorus export. Measure dry mass and P content and close the balance against the water line. Retain raw values, units and times, separate predictions from observations, and resolve discrepancies before treating a simulation as field validation.

In the offline workbench, select the observation point for closure and residual metal. Draw every boundary stream and separate uncertainty from inventory change. Retain raw values, units and times, separate predictions from observations, and resolve discrepancies before treating a simulation as field validation.
pitfalls: 總磷高但溶解磷低可能是固體流失。診斷與介入：重測總磷與溶解磷，將固體分離和水相反應分開診斷。
用 FeCl3 質量直接當元素鐵質量。診斷與介入：校對元素莫耳與藥品成分，再用平行瓶杯驗證。
泵耗液量沒有換算活性成分。診斷與介入：核對活性成分、流量和投加量換算，避免把示例作為推薦設定。
把百分濃度當作無單位的整數。診斷與介入：重新確認濃度標示、密度與計量泵實測出量。
攪拌器有轉動不代表混合均勻。診斷與介入：查實際傳入水中功率、黏度與死角，觀察絮體而非只看電表。
只延長時間而忽略局部剪切。診斷與介入：同時比較絮體破碎、沉降和殘濁，離線修正混合分段。
同時改三參數無法辨識主要原因。診斷與介入：重做同批原水平行試驗，分開藥量、剪切與時間的影響。
加藥有效卻因絮體外流仍有高總磷。診斷與介入：比較分池流量及沉降測試，先評估配流是否失衡。
只比較藥費而忽略污泥成本與質量。診斷與介入：重算乾固體與乾基含磷率，將濕重和元素質量分開。
pH 改變與殘餘金屬被漏列。診斷與介入：補列回流、庫存與採樣不確定度，保留無法解釋的差額。
pitfallsEn: High TP with low dissolved P can indicate solids escape. Diagnostic response: Remeasure total/dissolved P and diagnose solids separation separately from aqueous reactions.
FeCl3 mass is incorrectly treated as elemental Fe. Diagnostic response: Check elemental moles and reagent composition, then use parallel jar tests.
Solution consumption is not converted to active chemical. Diagnostic response: Check active strength, flow and dosing conversion; do not use the example as a recommended setting.
Using percent as a whole-number fraction gives a large error. Diagnostic response: Reconfirm concentration labeling, density and measured pump delivery.
A rotating mixer does not prove uniform mixing. Diagnostic response: Check power delivered to water, viscosity and dead zones, observing flocs rather than electricity alone.
Longer time alone ignores local shear. Diagnostic response: Compare breakup, settling and residual turbidity while revising mixing stages offline.
Changing three variables together hides causality. Diagnostic response: Repeat parallel tests on one water batch, separating dose, shear and time effects.
Successful precipitation can still leave high TP through floc escape. Diagnostic response: Compare cell flows and settling tests, first checking distribution imbalance.
Comparing reagent cost alone omits sludge burdens. Diagnostic response: Recalculate dry solids and dry-basis P content separately from wet mass.
pH shifts and residual metal are omitted. Diagnostic response: Add recycle, inventory and sampling uncertainty, retaining unexplained differences.

courses.connection: 本課以金屬鹽化學計量、膠體分離與新增污泥為主線，從除磷目標與成分、元素莫耳配比、活性成分日量、藥液濃度與密度進入十個相連的技術單元。每單元依機制、數量模型、驗證與失效辨識逐步操作，最後完成包含單位、敏感度及邊界的工程工作單。數值均為原創教學假設，不是特定設施實測或現場操作設定。
courses.connectionEn: This course develops metal-salt stoichiometry, colloid separation and added sludge through ten connected units, beginning with phosphorus target and fractions, elemental molar ratio, daily active-component mass, solution fraction and density. Each unit moves through mechanism, quantitative model, verification and failure diagnosis, ending in a worksheet with units, sensitivity and applicability. All example numbers are original teaching assumptions, not facility measurements or live operating settings.
